name: Laikou Sakura & Vitamin C Serum  17ml
description:
Laikou Sakura & Vitamin C Serum Combo – 17ml + 17ml

🌸 Brightening | Anti-Aging | Firming | Hydrating

Product Type: Facial Serum
Volume: 17ml x 2
Use: Face & Neck
Gender: Female
Origin: Made in Korea

Key Ingredients & Benefits:

Sodium Hyaluronate: Boosts skin elasticity, deeply hydrates, and reduces fine lines.

Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C): Brightens skin, removes freckles, and evens out skin tone.

Tremella Fuciformis Polysaccharide: Antioxidant-rich, deeply nourishes and protects skin.

Prunus Mume Fruit Extract: Stimulates collagen formation, fights wrinkles, and promotes anti-aging.

Features:

🌸 Whitening & Brightening: Reduces dark spots and dullness.

🌸 Firming & Anti-Wrinkle: Helps maintain youthful, resilient skin.

🌸 Anti-Puffiness: Reduces under-eye puffiness and fatigue signs.

🌸 Lightweight formula, absorbs quickly for daily use.

🌸 Suitable for all skin types.

✅ Best For: Whitening, anti-aging, anti-wrinkle, firming, brightening, puffiness reduction
✅ Gender: Female
